content: Patients with health insurance coverage should present their insurance card and a valid government-issued photo ID at the front desk before the consultation to initiate the claims process. The clinic's billing team will submit the claim directly to the insurer on behalf of the patient for empanelled insurance providers; a list of accepted insurers is available at the reception and on the clinic portal. For non-empanelled policies, patients pay the full consultation and procedure fees at the time of visit and receive an itemised receipt and a discharge summary to support a reimbursement claim filed directly with their insurer. Pre-authorisation from the insurer may be required for certain procedures; patients must arrange this before the appointment date. Disputes or queries about settled claims should be directed to the clinic's billing helpdesk during business hours.
